answer_1.quote: CFinBench comprises 99,100 questions spanning 43 second-level categories with 3 question types: single-choice, multiple-choice and judgment.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are answers to financial questions in Chinese, including selection of correct options for single-choice, multiple-choice, and judgment questions.

answer_2.quote: We adopt accuracy to measure the match between model prediction and gold answer.

answer_4.quote: we establish a financial team of more than 10 people with professional financial backgrounds and conduct three rounds of manual verification of the rephrased questions.
answer_4.guideline: The human evaluation involved verifying the correctness and quality of rephrased questions, including discarding low-quality questions and confirming high-confidence answers.
